correctness.rationale: An independent exact check (`python3 /workspace/checks/icosa.py`) builds the icosahedral graph from cyclic signed permutations of (0,1,phi), tests integer-pair squared distances in Z[phi], and computes graph distances by Floyd–Warshall. Applying the strict triangle inequalities to every triple in every subset yields f=(12,66,100,30) and 120 prohibited triples. The admissible triangle patterns are (1,1,1), (1,2,2), (2,2,2), with counts 20,60,20. The distance-two core is connected; its edges have two incident triangles and all links are five-cycles. Its Euler characteristic is 2, so it is a closed combinatorial sphere. Each adjacency edge has two candidate (1,2,2) triangles: choose one per edge. In the union of the core and these selected pairs each such edge is free in its own triangle, since that is its only adjacency edge; collapsing all pairs returns to the sphere. The six distance-three edges occur in no triangles. With them removed the remaining complex contains the simply connected enlarged core with the same one-skeleton, so cells of dimension >=2 cannot introduce fundamental-group generators. Each tetrahedron has two faces occurring in no other tetrahedron; choosing one each gives independent valid collapses and a simply connected two-complex of Euler characteristic 22. Its H2 is free of rank 21; Hurewicz and the simply connected homological Whitehead theorem give a wedge of 21 two-spheres. Reattaching the six bare edges adds one free circle per edge to this connected complex. The finite check establishes the combinatorial data only; the integral homotopy conclusion follows from these topological steps.

evidence: Anand et al. characterize individual GP sets and report a diameter-two result. The Resultary family classifications concern wheels, connected complete multipartite graphs, or an apex joined to disjoint connected triangle-free parts.
broader_coverage.reasoning: The icosahedral graph has diameter three and degree five at all twelve vertices: it has no universal apex and is neither a wheel nor a connected complete multipartite graph (which would have diameter at most two). A general face-membership test provides an enumeration route but does not imply the attaching-map and collapse results.

equivalent_formulations.reasoning: These are inequivalent notions of independence. GP permits all adjacency pairs and even adjacency triangles (all three distances are one), which separates it from both ordinary graph independence and dissociation. The GP graph metric is computed before taking a vertex subset.

value.rationale: For a natural Platonic graph, the full admissible-configuration topology distinguishes GP from independence and neighboring metric complexes. The exact 21 two-spheres, with six free antipodal one-cells, supply a useful structural benchmark not determined by the GP number or by face counts alone.
